_comment: Accepted high/critical advisories in the API's NuGet packages. Read by scripts/audit-nuget.js, which runs in CI. Same rules as .audit-allowlist.json: every entry needs a reason and a reviewBy date; the build fails once reviewBy passes, and again if the entry stops matching anything. Do not add an entry to silence a finding that has a usable patched version - upgrade instead.

allow.reason: CVE-2026-114147 (ASP.NET Core DoS), published 2026-11-11. Only fix on the 8.0 line is 8.0.34, published 2026-11-10 13:11 UTC and still inside the repo's 72h install cooldown. Bump every Microsoft 8.0.33 reference to 8.0.34 once it clears (2026-11-13 13:11 UTC) and delete this entry.

REACHABLE, decision pending. Tiled fax TIFF decoder heap OOB write. ImageNormalizer.Rescale calls Image.Load with the default configuration, which sniffs TIFF from content regardless of declared type, on organizer uploads, RemoteLogoFetcher (server-fetched logo URLs) and brand extraction (scraped sites). Fixed in 3.2.0, but 3.2.0 fails the build without a Six Labors license key. Options: obtain a license, or drop TIFF from ImageSharp's decoder configuration, or replace ImageSharp. Short date on purpose.

HistogramEqualization processor. The API never calls it (ImageNormalizer only resizes and encodes PNG). Fixed in 3.2.0, which needs a Six Labors license key; resolved together with GHSA-v76p-62qx-wwq2.
TIFF CCITT T4 ENCODER. The API only encodes PNG, never TIFF. Fixed in 3.2.0, which needs a Six Labors license key; resolved together with GHSA-v76p-62qx-wwq2.
